correctness.rationale: For rows (1,0),(1,0),(0,sqrt(2q/(1−q))) and targets (0,d,0), paired affine reflections are exactly three types: horizontal-horizontal with ±d or zero increments, vertical-vertical identity, and mixed pair with probability θ=2q(1−q) resetting X to 0 or d and Y to 0. This Doeblin coalescence yields TV distance ≤(1−θ)^n and a unique invariant geometric lattice law; its generating/characteristic function gives geometric ratio (sqrt(1+q)−sqrt(2q))/(sqrt(1+q)+sqrt(2q)), mean d/2 and variance d²/(4q). Conditional first and squared-error recurrences yield the exact finite-time formulas for arbitrary deterministic Z0; matched single-reflection projection gives floor d²/4. Characteristic-function scaling yields Laplace(0,1/(2sqrt2)). Independent rational enumeration verified all nine ordered pairs and first/second moments for q=1/4,1/2,3/4 and three starting vectors (9 exact cases).
